facts.fact: The government's 2027 budget orientations, reported on 2026-08-04, provide for generalising the integrated public finance system SIGFiP to all institutions, administrations, collectivités territoriales, public establishments, projects and diplomatic posts, for real-time monitoring of budget execution; no date, cost or number of local governments is given.
facts.system: Système intégré de gestion des finances publiques (SIGFiP), generalisation to collectivités territoriales

systems.system: Système intégré de gestion des finances publiques (SIGFiP)
systems.tiers: to be generalised to institutions, administrations, collectivités territoriales, public establishments, projects, programmes and diplomatic and consular posts; planned

systems.system: Virement électronique normalisé / factures électroniques normalisées (FEN)
systems.tiers: all public entities concerned, from the start of 2027; planned

note: The one fact is a stated intention, with no local government said to be on SIGFiP now; recorded as a plan for local governments to work in a national system, for the parent to accept or drop.
